Ever heard a language so ancient it was once called the speech of Himalayan night-demons?
Light your lantern and step inside Kashmir’s misty valley, where Vedic rishis chant on birch bark, Buddhist monks explore secrets in Prakrit, Shaivite yogis whisper mantras that melt into Sufi ghazals, and Persian poets paint the skyline with new words. In half and hour we’ll wander from Ashoka’s stupas to Sikandar’s shattered temples. By the end you’ll hear how a rugged Dardic dialect survived crusades, conquests, and centuries of snow to become the Kashmiri spoken today.
